summary: Describe the column headings of the feature collection and relax the pinned gazetteer marker description
upstreamWorkflow: Hand-authored in Insomnia; openapi.yaml and openapi.json are generated from it and must not be edited by hand.
liveOccurrence: wibarab staticData.geo[0].properties.column_headings — 96 items: { name }, { country }, { alternateNames } and 93 x { category, count, ft_* }; the same collection ships description "GEOJSON for the WIBARAB Feature DB" instead of the pinned "GEOJSON of the VICAV gazetteer"

ColumnHeading.title: One column of the feature collection

notes: The two branches of ColumnHeading are mutually exclusive: the plain branch has no category/count, the feature-type branch requires them.
The catch-all { "type": "object" } in FeatureCollection.properties stays — the collection metadata is deliberately a suggestion only.
Alternative to the GazetteerMarker change: keep the const and extend it to an enum of the known collection descriptions.
Verified against the live payload: all 96 headings validate, an unknown key is rejected.
